name: OpenViking
description: Serves agent memories, resources and skills as a virtual filesystem under viking:// URIs, loading context on demand across tiers instead of stuffing the prompt.

skills.name: Context Filesystem
skills.description: Exposes memories, files and skills as paths under a viking:// scheme that agents browse and read like a filesystem.

skills.name: On-Demand Loading
skills.description: Loads only the context slices an agent requests, keeping token usage flat as the stored corpus grows.

skills.name: Harness Plugins
skills.description: Plugs into Claude Code, Cursor and Codex so existing agent setups gain persistent context without rewrites.
